source.bar_text: As Kristndum (dt.: Christentum) is mid umara zwoa Milliardn Mitglieda vuam Islam und am Hinduismus de gressde Religion vo da Wejd und oane vo de fimf Wejdreligjona.

Bavarian text:
As Kristndum (dt.: Christentum) is mid umara zwoa Milliardn Mitglieda vuam Islam und am Hinduismus de gressde Religion vo da Wejd und oane vo de fimf Wejdreligjona.

translation: Christianity (German: Christentum) is with around two billion members before Islam and Hinduism the largest religion in the world and one of the five world religions.
